content.caption:
72-hour household preparedness plan: pay what you want, starting at 2 PLN.

Here's why Ready72h works this way:

Safety is not a place to profit off people's anxiety.

So the minimum price unlocks the full planner and the free companion web app. That includes the 72-hour supply checklist, the family communication plan and the "15 minutes to leave the house" bag checklist.

The suggested price is 59 PLN. If you can pay it, great. If not, 2 PLN gets you the same thing.

It's based on guidance from Sweden's MSB, Germany's BBK and Poland's RCB. There are two editions, apartment and house with garden.

Which edition do you need: apartment or house?

Comment "PLAN" and I'll send you the link in DM — or tap the link in bio.
